2607.22016.title: EVL-MCoT: Enhanced Vision-Language Multi-CoT for Harmful Meme Detection
2607.22016.paper_summary: MEMEs are widely used on the internet and often carry strong elements of sarcasm or irony. Understanding their hidden meanings typically requires a joint interpretation of text and vision. Existing methods focus on the dual-stream vision-language model to extract the visual and text simultaneously, which lacks background information and prior knowledge about the comprehensive explanation of MEME. One feasible option is to adopt chain-of-thought (CoT). However, the simple CoT approach lacks multi-perspective thinking, which may compromise the reliability of the resulting answers. Moreover, it often relies on shallow feature fusion, lacking the fusion of local details and fine-grained visual-prompt text alignment. This limitation prevents a deeper understanding of the intricate connections between the visual and the text. Herein, an enhanced vision-language multi-CoT (EVL-MCoT) approach is proposed to address these limitations. By promoting multi-CoT, EVL-MCoT enhances consistency and reduces bias in the decision-making process. Additionally, we design a prototype-guided and context-guided decoding framework, which incorporates visual prototypes to guide the fusion process and enables the model to align textual and visual information more precisely. We achieve promising results on the HatefulMemes and MultiOff datasets. The source code has been publicly released and is available at https://github.com/BGWH123/EVL-MCoT.
2607.22016.paper_summary_zh: MEME 在互聯網上被廣泛使用，並且通常帶有強烈的諷刺或反諷元素。理解它們隱藏的含義通常需要對文本和視覺的聯合解釋。現有的方法專注於雙流視覺-語言模型，以同時提取視覺和文本，但缺乏關於 MEME 的全面解釋的背景信息和先前知識。一個可行的選擇是採用思維鏈（CoT）。然而，簡單的 CoT 方法缺乏多角度思考，這可能會妨礙最終答案的可靠性。此外，它通常依賴於淺層特徵融合，缺乏局部細節的融合和細緻的視覺提示文本對齊。這一限制阻礙了對視覺和文本之間複雜聯繫的深入理解。在此，我們提出了一種增強的視覺-語言多思維鏈（EVL-MCoT）方法，以解決這些限制。通過促進多思維鏈，EVL-MCoT 增強了一致性並減少了決策過程中的偏見。此外，我們設計了一個原型引導和上下文引導的解碼框架，該框架結合了視覺原型來引導融合過程，並使模型能夠更精確地對齊文本和視覺信息。我們在 HatefulMemes 和 MultiOff 數據集上取得了良好的結果。源代碼已公開發布，並可在 https://github.com/BGWH123/EVL-MCoT 獲得。
